## 2025-06-06 - Enhancing Developer Experience (DX) via OpenAPI Metadata
**Learning:** For backend-only services lacking a frontend UI, the API documentation (Swagger/Redoc) serves as the primary user interface. Small enhancements to OpenAPI metadata—like adding endpoint summaries, logical tagging, and parameter descriptions—substantially improve discoverability and usability for developers interacting with the service.
**Action:** Always verify that route decorators and input parameters have adequate metadata to ensure the auto-generated documentation is intuitive and accessible.
